plugin.name: Widescreen Fix
hudaspect.description: Constrains the HUD to an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9 on wider screens. Auto uses the whole screen.
menuaspect.description: Constrains the menus and their mouse input to a centered canvas of this aspect ratio. Auto uses the whole screen.
scmaspect.description: Constrains the drawings of the mission scripts (mini games, timers, menus of shops) to an aspect ratio. Auto follows the HUD aspect ratio.
hudwidth.description: Width of the HUD elements. The original size is 1.0.
hudheight.description: Height of the HUD elements. The original size is 1.0.
radarwidth.description: Width of the radar. The original game uses 94, GTA IV's proportions are the default.
radarheight.description: Height of the radar. The original game uses 76, GTA IV's proportions are the default.
subtitlesscale.description: Size of the subtitles. The original size is 1.0.
borderanim.description: Slides the cutscene borders in and out. Off shows and hides them at once, like the original game.
weaponicon.description: Keeps the weapon icon at its proportions instead of stretching it to the HUD's size.
fov.description: Multiplies the field of view of the gameplay cameras, on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the game's own; cutscenes keep theirs.
fmvmode.description: How the intro videos fit the screen: at their original aspect ratio with black bars, filling the screen at their aspect ratio (the edges are cut), or stretched.
skipintro.description: Starts at the main menu, without the logo videos.
carspeedfov.description: The field of view widens with the speed of the car, as in the PlayStation 2 version.
vcscamshake.description: Shakes the camera in fast vehicles, like Vice City Stories.
antialiasing.description: SMAA smooths the edges after the frame is drawn.
aasharpness.description: Sharpening of TAA, DLAA and FSR.
graphicsapi.description: Direct3D 9 is the system's. Vulkan (DXVK) is offered once FusionFixHub installed DXVK; DLAA and FSR need it.
d3d9on12.description: Offers Windows' D3D9on12 as a Graphics API, for testing only.
consolegamma.description: A gamma curve with deeper contrast, like GTA IV on the Xbox 360.
speedblur.description: Turns off the motion blur overlay of fast vehicles. The other post-processing stays.
transparentmenu.description: Shows the game blurred behind the pause menu instead of the menu's background.
fullscreenbg.description: Extends the menu backgrounds to the whole screen by repeating a column without artwork. Turn it off for replaced backgrounds of the original sizes. Transparent Menu takes precedence.
hqradardisc.description: Draws the radar's ring at a higher resolution when the game's own low resolution texture is used.
textoutline.description: Replaces the shadow of the HUD's and menus' text with an outline.
menufps.description: Frame rate limit of the menus. The gameplay limit is the game's own Frame Limiter in the display settings.
noislandloading.description: Loads all islands at once, so there is no loading screen between them. Needs more memory and CPU time.
nointeriorloading.description: Seamless transitions between interiors and the city.
zonecull.description: Stops objects from disappearing at the edges of the game's zones.
fullscreenmap.description: Shows the map of the pause menu on the whole screen. It ignores the menu aspect ratio.
pausefocus.description: The game pauses when its window loses the focus. Off keeps it running in the background (windowed mode only).
crosshairdot.description: Hides the small white dot of the crosshair of some weapons.
msaa.description: Forces MSAA at this level: a number of samples, or max for the highest the graphics card supports. Off keeps the game's choice. TAA, DLAA and FSR are only offered without it.
hideaabug.description: Draws 1 pixel lines at the screen's edges to hide the lines MSAA leaves there.
scalingmode.description: Which HUD scaling the fix uses. The new one constrains and scales every element; the old one is the fix's earlier scaling, with Radar Width Scale and Radar Height Scale.
radarwidthscale.description: Width of the radar with the old HUD scaling. The original size is 1.0.
radarheightscale.description: Height of the radar with the old HUD scaling. The original size is 1.0.
textlanguage.description: The language of the fix's options in the game's menu, and of the other plugins' pages there. Auto follows the game's language; choose one when a translation of the game replaced its language.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
legacy.mode.description: Use the previous fix implementation for mod compatibility. Modern renderer effects and fix menus are unavailable in this mode. Configure Legacy options below; shared subtitle scale and multisampling also apply. Restart required. No legacy INI is read or migrated.
legacy.ResX.description: Width in pixels: -1 leaves native resolution selection; zero selects the desktop. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.ResY.description: Height in pixels: -1 leaves native resolution selection; zero selects the desktop. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.ForceAspectRatio.description: Scene aspect ratio as auto or width:height. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.FrontendAspectRatio.description: Frontend texture aspect ratio as auto or width:height. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.DontTouchFOV.description: Disable the legacy FOV corrections. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.RestoreCutsceneFOV.description: Use the original FOV during cutscenes. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.HudWidthScale.description: Legacy HUD width multiplier. Zero restores the original value of one. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.HudHeightScale.description: Legacy HUD height multiplier. Zero restores the original value 1.0714285. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
legacy.RadarWidthScale.description: Legacy radar width multiplier. Zero restores the original value of one. Legacy implementation only. Restart required.
